_comment: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Sources: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-ua7-pq-e2e-sessions.md (§4, §6, §7, §10), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-pqchat-public-topics.md (§2), plan block "Group 3c" (3C-D3, 3C-D5, 3C-D9). UNAUDITED. KEM keys and wraps (spec P14, §6.1, §6.2). kemKeys: ML-KEM-1024 keygen(mlkemSeed, 64 B) gives ek (1,568 B) and dk; pkX = X25519(x25519Secret, 9); kemPk = 0x01 ‖ ek ‖ pkX (1,601 B); kemPkHash = keccak256(kemPk). p14: the check before every encapsulation, run with p14.mlkemM and p14.x25519Secret; refusals by name: "wrong scheme byte" (kemPk[0] != 1), "wrong length" (not 1,601 B), "modulus check" (ByteEncode12(ByteDecode12(ek[0:1536])) != ek[0:1536], i.e. a 12-bit coefficient >= 3329; coefficients little-endian as FIPS 203), "all-zero X25519" (a low-order pkX: X25519(e, pkX) is all zero). wraps: (ctM, ssM) = ML-KEM-1024.Encaps(ek, m = mlkemM); E = X25519(x25519Secret, 9); ssX = X25519(x25519Secret, pkX); ss = SHA3-256(ssM ‖ ssX ‖ E ‖ pkX ‖ "scaas.kem.1"); kek = HKDF-SHA-256(ikm ss, empty salt, info "scaas/pqchat/v1/wrap" ‖ sessionId ‖ epochId ‖ member ‖ u64be keyId ‖ 0x01 ‖ kemPkHash, 32 B); sealedKey = AES-256-GCM(kek, nonce 0^96, K, aad sessionId ‖ epochId ‖ member ‖ u64be keyId) (48 B, tag last); wrap = the Wrap struct, hashStruct its EIP-712 hash. The receiver (kemKey) reopens K with dk and x25519Secret. Epoch 0's epochId is its sessionId.
